messages:
Ravi (partnerships): quick sync request 24 planning a marketplace private-offer that bundles a co-sell voucher + SOW (SI) credit + renewal smoothing. need buy-in on economics & lifecycle.
Maya (sales): sounds promising. can we make the sales pitch chop-heavy? AEs prefer a single headline number.
Ravi (partnerships): headline idea: "Commit X, get Y in marketplace credits + $Z co-sell voucher". keep language simple.
Ellen (solutions): on SOW credits: recommend they be milestone-based: 50% on kickoff, 50% on go-live. avoids redemption delays and ensures partner delivery.
Tom (finance): two asks: (1) cap total voucher liability per account (suggest $50k), (2) define how credits are recorded for revenue recognition. marketplace-labeled credits often reduce ARR vs separate vendor credits.
Priya (revops): operationally we can create 3 offer SKUs: bronze/silver/gold. sample bands: $75k, $350k, $900k commits. discounts 15/28/38%. co-sell voucher: $5k/$20k/$45k. SOW credit: 4% of commit for bronze, 6% silver, 8% gold.
Liam (legal): we need to confirm whether vouchers can be transferred to partners or must be applied by buyer only. also anti-fraud checks on redemption. will draft clause.
marketplace-bot: FYI: GCP marketplace supports private offers with usage SKUs and one-time SKUs, but quota/entitlement limits vary by marketplace. see partner docs.
Maya (sales): re: pro-rate on upgrades: AEs need a simple rule. propose: if customer upgrades commit mid-term, new tier pricing applies from effective date; SOW credit for incremental commit only.
Ellen (solutions): SOW credit for incremental commit makes sense. also suggest an "accelerator" for customers who hit 75% of commit within 90 days: unlock an additional 2% discount applied next invoice. helps early-adopters.
Ravi (partnerships): love the accelerator. Tom, does that create recognition complexity?
Tom (finance): small, but manageable. model assumption: 30% of customers will hit accelerator. we'll include a reserve in the forecast.
Priya (revops): question: voucher redemption window? Recommend 365 days for hardware purchases; SOW credit redemption must occur within 180 days and be invoiced by partner.
Liam (legal): require partner statement of work and invoice for SOW credit redemption. also require partner compliance attestation for co-sell voucher use.
Maya (sales): marketing ask: can we bundle a 90-day technical engagement (free) with gold to speed proof-of-value? would rather be framed as partner-funded but credited back via SOW credit to avoid Redwood OPEX.
Ellen (solutions): partner-funded trial + Redwood tech review makes sense, capture as part of partner onboarding checklist.
Ravi (partnerships): ok action items: Priya prototype SKU mapping + lifecycle (voucher SKU, one-time SOW SKU, usage SKU) and redemption rules by Fri.
Priya (revops): will do. will include sample invoice lines and how they show in Console.
Tom (finance): I'll run a sensitivity on voucher redemption rates and accelerator uptake by Mon. need sample pipeline to test.
Liam (legal): I'll circulate voucher/SOW T&Cs and redemption template by Mon.
Maya (sales): I'll draft AE one-liner + two sample closing scripts. targeting Tue COB.
Ellen (solutions): I'll write the partner SOW template and milestone checklist. ETA Tue.
Ravi (partnerships): great. plan review Wed 11am. calling out potential pilot candidates: @Maya pls flag any F500 deals with infra spend focus that could take gold.
Maya (sales): flagged two deals in SF and one on Azure enterprise. pinging AEs.
Ravi (partnerships): last operational note: include a "voucher audit" event in Console that logs redemption and partner approval. helps compliance and reporting.
Priya (revops): will add voucher audit + redemption status to the Console voucher card (states: available / requested / approved / applied).
Ravi (partnerships): thanks all. objective: simple buyer message, predictable partner economics, and clear ops flows. we'll iterate after pilot. :thumbsup:
